visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair stands in a well-lit indoor room wearing a black tank top and leggings. She smiles and gestures with her hands towards the camera. Behind her is a wooden staircase and a window showing a garden. (2) The woman picks up a bright neon green snow suit and begins putting on the pants. She adjusts the waist and shows off the fit. The room has neutral-toned walls and wooden furniture. (3) She sits down to pull on a pair of matching lime green socks, stretching them over her feet. (4) The woman puts on a matching neon green hooded snow jacket, zipping it up halfway. She turns to show the side and back of the jacket. (5) Transition to an outdoor snowy environment with mountains and trees in the background. The woman puts on a black neck warmer, then fits a white helmet over her head and pulls down pink-tinted goggles. (6) A close-up shows her putting on black snow gloves and adjusting the straps. (7) She puts on a pair of tan and black snowboard boots, pulling the laces tight. The boots rest on a snowy ground. (8) She steps her boots into black bindings on a snowboard that has a pink and white floral pattern. (9) The woman is filmed snowboarding down a wide, groomed ski slope. Other skiers are visible in the distance under a clear blue sky with mountains surrounding the area. (10) She holds her snowboard up to the camera, showing the floral design on the front and an alien-themed design on another board behind her. She smiles warmly at the lens.
